## Summary

Adds a new MCP \(Model Context Protocol\) server package that provides AI assistants with access to Zinnia Design System documentation.

### What''s included

- **MCP server** \(`@zapier/design-system-mcp`\) with 6 tools:
  - `list_components` - Browse components by package
  - `get_component_docs` - Full component documentation with props
  - `list_tokens` - List semantic/primitive token categories
  - `get_token_docs` - Token values in CSS/JS/SCSS formats
  - `get_layout_docs` - Universal layout hooks, types, constants
  - `search` - Full-text search across all documentation

- **Documentation extractors** that parse source code to generate docs:
  - Component extraction from `@zapier/design-system`, `@zapier/design-system-beta`, `@zapier/universal-layout`
  - Token extraction from `@zapier/design-tokens`
  - Universal layout hooks, types, and constants extraction
  - Supernova docs indexing \(temporary, easily removable\)

- **SQLite FTS5 search index** for fast full-text search

- **Tool descriptions** that guide AI assistants toward best practices:
  - Use design tokens instead of hardcoded values
  - Check for deprecated components and use replacements
  - Follow accessibility requirements \(contrast, touch targets, labels\)
  - Prefer semantic tokens over primitives

## Quick Start

### Claude Code

Add to `.mcp.json` \(project-level\) or `~/.claude/settings.json` \(user-level\):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "design-system-mcp": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@zapier/design-system-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

Then restart Claude Code or run `/mcp` to connect.

### Cursor

Add to `.cursor/mcp.json` \(project-level\) or `~/.cursor/mcp.json` \(user-level\):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "design-system-mcp": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@zapier/design-system-mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

Then restart Cursor to connect.

## Test plan

- [ ] Run `pnpm build` in `packages/design-system-mcp`
- [ ] Connect MCP server to Claude Code or Cursor
- [ ] Test `list_components` returns component list
- [ ] Test `get_component_docs` returns markdown with props
- [ ] Test `search` returns relevant results
- [ ] Verify tool descriptions appear in MCP client

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code]\(https://claude.ai/code\)
EOF
